briefing: - 清单无KEV或勒索标记，暂未见在野利用证据。
- Apache多条10.0分漏洞集中披露，产品版本待补。
- freerdp两处9.8分漏洞已有POC，应优先升级至3.32.2。
- 命令注入与越权高危集中，暴露面系统需立即排查。
- 未见勒索软件关联，但高危RCE仍需按暴露优先级处置。

items.title: FreeRDP rdpgfx通道UAF致客户端失陷
items.title_zh: FreeRDP rdpgfx通道UAF致客户端失陷
items.summary_zh: 恶意RDP服务端用重名新ChannelId覆盖回调槽，关闭后再发PDU触发UAF，可致崩溃或代码执行
items.action_zh: 升级FreeRDP至3.32.2及以上，勿连接不可信RDP服务端
items.repro_note: 需架恶意RDP服务端，诱导客户端连接并关闭通道后向原通道发PDU
items.impact_scope: RDP客户端，连接恶意服务端触发
items.description: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 has a use-after-free in the client's rdpgfx dynamic virtual channel: a duplicate-name channel with a new ChannelId overwrites the listener's single callback slot, which rdpgfx_on_close frees without clearing. A malicious RDP server can open and close such a channel, then send a PDU on the original channel to crash the client or potentially execute code.

items.title: FreeRDP代理位图缓存V2越界写入
items.title_zh: FreeRDP代理位图缓存V2越界写入
items.summary_zh: 恶意RDP服务端下发numCellCaches异常的能力集PDU，代理按固定索引访问导致越界写，可崩溃或执行代码
items.action_zh: 升级至3.32.2及以上；避免连接不可信RDP服务端
items.repro_note: 以恶意服务端发送bitmap cache v2能力集，令numCellCaches取异常值
items.impact_scope: RDP客户端代理，连接恶意服务端触发
items.description: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 has an out-of-bounds write in the proxy because rdp_read_bitmap_cache_v2_capability_set rejects only numCellCaches values above 5, yet the bitmap cache v2 cell array is later accessed at fixed indices 0 through 4. A client connecting to the proxy can declare fewer than five cell caches in its Confirm Active, causing heap corruption, heap data leakage to the backend, or a crash.

items.title: ModSecurity文件名解析差异可绕过WAF
items.title_zh: ModSecurity文件名解析差异可绕过WAF
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造特殊文件名，使后端与WAF解析结果不一致，绕过检测将未检内容送入应用
items.action_zh: 升级ModSecurity修复版本；对上传文件名做规范化复核
items.repro_note: 构造含特殊字符/编码的文件名multipart上传，比对WAF与后端解析
items.impact_scope: WAF防护面，后端应用暴露风险
items.description: ModSecurity is an open source, cross platform web application firewall (WAF) engine for Apache, IIS and Nginx. Applications that use the backend-selected name for storage, extension checks, or content-type inference can therefore receive a filename that bypassed WAF inspection.

items.title: ModSecurity响应类型大小写绕过阻断
items.title_zh: ModSecurity响应类型大小写绕过阻断
items.summary_zh: 未认证请求者利用Content-Type大小写不一致，使phase 4本应阻断的响应内容（含敏感报错）被返回
items.action_zh: 升级至3.0.17之后版本；MIME比较改为大小写不敏感
items.repro_note: 让响应Content-Type带不同大小写，观察SecResponseBodyMimeType规则是否失效
items.impact_scope: WAF响应体检测，敏感信息外泄
items.description: From 3.0.0 until 3.0.17, src/transaction.cc compares a response Content-Type value against SecResponseBodyMimeType entries case-sensitively. An unauthenticated requester can then receive response content that a phase 4 rule would otherwise block, including sensitive error or debug data.

items.title: OpenSSH sshd musl环境密码认证绕过
items.title_zh: OpenSSH sshd musl环境密码认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者用256至1024字符超长密码即可登录部分账户，影响musl无PAM如Alpine环境
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至10.6p2；或改用PAM并限制密码长度策略
items.repro_note: 对musl且无PAM的sshd，用≥256字符密码尝试认证并观察结果
items.impact_scope: Linux SSH入口，容器/Alpine环境常见
items.description: sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux, when musl libc is used without PAM, lacks a workaround for a password authentication bypass (related to misinterpretation of whether a string is intended to be a password hash). For some configurations of accounts, any password between 256 and 1024 characters succeeds. An example of a platform using musl libc without PAM is Alpine Linux.

items.title: VRPN消息处理栈越界写入
items.title_zh: VRPN消息处理栈越界写入
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程对端发送长度索引未校验的sender/type消息，越界写栈缓冲区，可致崩溃或代码执行
items.action_zh: 升级至07.36之后版本；限制VRPN端口仅内网可达
items.repro_note: 向VRPN端口发送构造的sender/type消息，令长度索引越过栈缓冲
items.impact_scope: VR/科研内网组件，少见公网暴露
items.description: VRPN through 07.36 contains an out-of-bounds stack write vulnerability in vrpn_Endpoint::handle_sender_message() and handle_type_message() that allows unauthenticated remote peers to write outside a stack buffer via an unchecked length index. Attackers can connect, complete the version-cookie exchange, and send a SENDER_DESCRIPTION or TYPE_DESCRIPTION message with an out-of-range or negative index to crash the process.

items.title: BaSyx Helm图表明文存放Keycloak密钥
items.title_zh: BaSyx Helm图表明文存放Keycloak密钥
items.summary_zh: 能读ConfigMap者可取得OAuth2客户端密钥，获得BaSyx全部仓库与注册表的读写执行权限
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级Helm图表并轮换密钥，改用Secret存储
items.repro_note: 读取aas-basyx-v2-full部署ConfigMap中client secret并换取令牌
items.impact_scope: K8s内BaSyx部署，需集群读权限
items.description: In Eclipse BaSyx Helm Charts version 2.2.0 of the `aas-basyx-v2-full` chart, deployments with the bundled Keycloak enabled store the client secret of the `basyx-technical-user` OAuth2 client in cleartext in a Kubernetes ConfigMap. That token grants full create, read, update, delete and execute rights on all BaSyx repositories and registries in the deployment.

items.title: Apache OFBiz匿名请求加载恶意widget致RCE
items.title_zh: Apache OFBiz匿名请求加载恶意widget致RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者先multipart上传恶意widget XML，再用匿名JSON请求覆盖mainDecoratorLocation，触发加载并执行代码
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至24.09.08；临时限制上传与匿名JSON路由
items.repro_note: 先上传恶意widget XML，再用匿名JSON覆盖mainDecoratorLocation加载
items.impact_scope: 公网ERP应用，未认证RCE风险高
items.description: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') in Apache OFBiz 24.09 before 24.09.08 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server by staging crafted widget XML in a multipart upload and overriding the mainDecoratorLocation used by a manager login route through an anonymous JSON request, causing OFBiz to load the staged XML through its live screen descriptor mechanism and evaluate an unsandboxed Groovy expression while rendering the …

items.title: Keycloak SAML签名绕过致账号接管
items.title_zh: Keycloak SAML签名绕过致账号接管
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可提交伪造的未签名SAML消息,绕过签名校验后接管联邦用户账号。
items.affected: Red Hat(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至Red Hat修复版本;强制校验SAML断言签名
items.repro_note: 未授权SAML HTTP-Redirect端点,构造未签名Response替换合法断言
items.impact_scope: 统一身份认证IdP,常暴露公网
items.description: A flaw was found in the SAML HTTP-Redirect binding implementation of Keycloak. The issue occurs because the server processes percent-encoded parameter names (like %53AMLResponse) while the signature verification logic only checks literal parameter names. An attacker can use this discrepancy to provide a crafted, unsigned SAML message that the server processes instead of a legitimately signed one, leading to full account takeover of federated users.

items.title: Apache Juneau请求头未脱敏写入日志
items.title_zh: Apache Juneau请求头未脱敏写入日志
items.summary_zh: 请求触发服务端错误时，默认REST调用日志记录未脱敏请求头，Authorization等凭据落入日志文件
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；关闭或脱敏调用日志中的请求头
items.repro_note: 发送带Authorization等敏感头且触发500的请求，检查日志内容
items.impact_scope: Java REST服务端，日志侧信道泄露
items.description: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability in Apache Juneau. The default REST server call logger records request headers for requests that end in a server error, without redacting them.

items.title: Apache Juneau错误响应泄露内部异常
items.title_zh: Apache Juneau错误响应泄露内部异常
items.summary_zh: 任意客户端触发错误响应，即可从Thrown响应头与错误体获取内部异常类名与消息
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；关闭异常详情回显与Thrown头
items.repro_note: 构造触发服务端异常的REST请求，查看Thrown头及错误体内容
items.impact_scope: Java REST服务端，暴露内部实现细节
items.description: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information vulnerability in Apache Juneau. The REST server sends the internal exception class and message to clients in a "Thrown" response header on every error response, and can include internal exception messages in the error body, even when stack-trace rendering is disabled.

items.title: Apache Juneau RestClient重定向泄露凭
items.title_zh: Apache Juneau RestClient重定向泄露凭
items.summary_zh: 服务端返回跨主机或HTTPS降HTTP重定向时，RestClient仍携带Authorization、Cookie、X-API-Key等头
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；禁止客户端跟随跨域或降级重定向
items.repro_note: 让RestClient访问会302到其他主机的服务，抓包确认凭据头外发
items.impact_scope: Java客户端侧，凭据外泄至第三方
items.description: Insufficiently Protected Credentials vulnerability in Apache Juneau. The Apache Juneau RestClient followed HTTP redirects while keeping credential headers from the original request, so a server that redirected the client to a different host or port, or from HTTPS to HTTP, could receive headers such as Authorization, Cookie, Proxy-Authorization and X-API-Key.

items.title: Apache Juneau响应头CRLF注入可分裂响应
items.title_zh: Apache Juneau响应头CRLF注入可分裂响应
items.summary_zh: 远程客户端向由请求数据拼接的响应头或跳转目标注入CRLF，实现响应分裂或任意站点跳转
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；过滤响应头与跳转目标中的CR/LF
items.repro_note: 在拼入响应头或跳转目标的请求参数中注入%0d%0a验证
items.impact_scope: Java Web应用，缓存投毒与钓鱼跳转
items.description: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences in HTTP Headers ('HTTP Response Splitting') vulnerability in Apache Juneau. An application that sets a response header or redirect target from request data could let a remote client inject header lines (where the servlet container does not itself reject CR/LF) or redirect users to an arbitrary external site.

items.title: Apache Juneau请求变量反射导致XSS
items.title_zh: Apache Juneau请求变量反射导致XSS
items.summary_zh: 应用将请求头、表单或路径值未编码回显到页面，攻击者可构造链接诱导用户执行脚本
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；对所有反射输出做HTML编码
items.repro_note: 在回显的请求头或路径参数中注入脚本标签，观察是否原样输出
items.impact_scope: Java Web页面，需诱导用户访问
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Apache Juneau. Applications whose chrome includes request-derived variables, such as request headers, form data or path values, reflect those values unencoded, allowing cross-site scripting.

items.title: Apache OFBiz外部登录键可重放劫持会话
items.title_zh: Apache OFBiz外部登录键可重放劫持会话
items.summary_zh: 截获有效externalLoginKey的远程攻击者无需Cookie即可重放，取得该用户可访问全部webapp的会话
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至24.09.08；强制HTTPS并缩短externalLoginKey有效期
items.repro_note: 抓取URL中的externalLoginKey，换客户端重放并访问后台功能
items.impact_scope: 对外ERP系统，会话完全接管
items.description: Authentication Bypass by Capture-replay in ExternalLoginKeysManager in Apache OFBiz 24.09 before 24.09.08 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker who captures a live externalLoginKey value to obtain a complete, cookie-free, reusable session as the user who issued it, in every webapp that user can reach, because checkExternalLoginKey runs as a global preprocessor ahead of both the CSRF and authentication checks and accepts the key as a bearer credential that is never bound to a …

items.title: OpenHuman外部渠道消息注入持久任务
items.title_zh: OpenHuman外部渠道消息注入持久任务
items.summary_zh: 可向已配置外部渠道发消息者，在无人工审批下创建以运行时用户权限执行的定时shell任务
items.action_zh: 升级至0.57.13；限制外部渠道来源与调度器权限
items.repro_note: 通过已配置外部渠道发送构造消息，检查是否生成cron持久任务
items.impact_scope: AI代理运行时，外部渠道为入口
items.description: Before version 0.57.13, an attacker who can send messages to a configured external channel can cause the agent to create persistent shell cron jobs without human approval. The scheduler later executes these jobs with the privileges of the OpenHuman runtime user.

items.title: LMFDB render_knowl接口SSTI致RCE
items.title_zh: LMFDB render_knowl接口SSTI致RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向/knowledge/render注入Jinja表达式，触达Python内建并执行系统命令
items.action_zh: 升级至修复提交；限制或下线/knowledge/render接口
items.repro_note: 向/knowledge/render/<ID>的查询串或content注入Jinja表达式
items.impact_scope: 数学数据库Web站，多为公网服务
items.description: LMFDB before commit 01829bd contains a server-side template injection vulnerability in the render_knowl function that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject Jinja expressions via request parameters. Attackers can supply crafted query-string values or 'content' data to /knowledge/render/<ID> to reach Python builtins and execute operating system commands as the web application account.

items.title: OpenEMR低权限用户文档越权读写
items.title_zh: OpenEMR低权限用户文档越权读写
items.summary_zh: 低权限登录用户可将任意文档改派到自己可访问的患者或分类，再经正常读取路径取得内容
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；收紧文档改派与读取的权限校验
items.repro_note: 低权限账号调用文档改派接口指向自有患者，再用读取接口获取
items.impact_scope: 医疗HIS内网，患者文档横向越权
items.description: OpenEMR is a free and open source electronic health records and medical practice management application. A low-privilege authenticated user can reassign an arbitrary document to a patient or category the user can access and then retrieve it through the normally protected read path.

items.title: 共享流水线接口缺失授权可注入版本
items.title_zh: 共享流水线接口缺失授权可注入版本
items.summary_zh: 低权限租户可创建共享流水线或注入受控版本；API直连无认证代理时未授权即可利用
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；API前置认证代理并校验写权限
items.repro_note: 以低权限或无凭据调用共享流水线写接口，注入受控版本
items.impact_scope: CI/CD流水线，供应链投毒风险
items.description: A low-privilege tenant can create shared pipelines or inject attacker-controlled versions into existing shared pipelines without the required write permission; if the API server is directly reachable without an authenticating proxy, an unauthenticated caller can exploit the same bypass, while deployments protected by such a proxy do not expose anonymous access.

items.title: OPNsense证书插件命令注入提权至root
items.title_zh: OPNsense证书插件命令注入提权至root
items.summary_zh: 具备证书签发/续期权限的登录用户经WebGUI或API注入命令，以root身份执行任意代码
items.action_zh: 升级os-acme-client插件至修复版本；收敛证书管理权限
items.repro_note: 在Google Cloud DNS验证配置字段注入shell元字符并触发签发
items.impact_scope: 边界防火墙设备，登录后提至root
items.description: An OS Command Injection vulnerability was discovered in the Google Cloud DNS validation module of the OPNsense os-acme-client plugin through 4.17. A remote authenticated user with privileges to issue or renew certificates through the WebGUI/API can achieve arbitrary code execution as root.

items.title: MONAI Label恶意DICOM污染推理结果
items.title_zh: MONAI Label恶意DICOM污染推理结果
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者上传特制DICOM，使NaN/Inf贯穿预处理、推理与写回，致推理失败或数据持久污染
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；上传前校验像素值并隔离推理环境
items.repro_note: 向默认MONAILabel上传含NaN/Inf像素的DICOM，观察推理与写回
items.impact_scope: 医疗AI推理服务，数据完整性受损
items.description: MONAI (Medical Open Network for AI) is an AI toolkit for health care imaging. An unauthenticated attacker who can upload a crafted DICOM to a default MONAILabel deployment can propagate NaN or infinity values through LoadImaged, Spacingd, model inference, and output writing, causing inference failures, persistent datastore poisoning, or geometrically corrupted results.

items.title: FreeSWITCH长度校验堆溢出致崩溃
items.title_zh: FreeSWITCH长度校验堆溢出致崩溃
items.summary_zh: 远程未认证攻击者发送特制报文触发堆溢出,可致服务崩溃、全部并发会话中断。
items.action_zh: 升级FreeSWITCH至修复版本,收敛SIP端口暴露面
items.repro_note: 向SIP端口发特制报文,令长度低16位为负触发超大计数拷贝
items.impact_scope: VoIP/SIP核心交换,常暴露公网
items.description: A value whose surviving low word became negative bypassed the signed size check and was reinterpreted as an enormous unsigned count, causing client bytes to overwrite memory beyond the 64 KiB receive buffer. The heap overwrite can corrupt connection pointers and crash FreeSWITCH, ending every concurrent session, although remote code execution has not been demonstrated.

items.title: AI Agent审批门绕过致命令执行
items.title_zh: AI Agent审批门绕过致命令执行
items.summary_zh: 默认监督策略下缺少审批上下文即放行node_exec,攻击者可绕过审批执行任意命令。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本;审批上下文缺失时默认拒绝
items.repro_note: 默认策略且Node启用时,缺失APPROVAL_CHAT_CONTEXT调用node_exec
items.impact_scope: AI Agent执行平台,内网自动化枢纽
items.description: Under the default Supervised autonomy policy with Node enabled, node_exec is classified as a write operation that should prompt for approval, but ApprovalGate treats missing APPROVAL_CHAT_CONTEXT as a non-interactive turn and allows execution. Because Yuanbao direct messages are open by default, an external sender who can message the connected bot can influence the agent to execute JavaScript and operating-system commands as the OpenHuman user without an approval prompt.

items.title: PowerSYSTEM Center SQL注入
items.difficulty: 中(需相邻网络·需低权限)
items.description: Insufficient input validation in the PowerSYSTEM Center report designer allows an authenticated user to execute unauthorized SQL commands.

items.title: FreeSWITCH媒体面认证欺骗
items.title_zh: FreeSWITCH媒体面认证欺骗
items.summary_zh: 链路中间攻击者可伪造媒体与认证信息,窃听并注入SIP/WebRTC通话内容。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本,强制SIP/WebRTC启用DTLS-SRTP
items.repro_note: 需处于通话链路中间,拦截并伪造媒体及ICE协商数据
items.impact_scope: SIP/WebRTC媒体面,链路旁路风险
items.description: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware. On unencrypted legs this enables eavesdropping and media injection, while all WebRTC and SIP legs that negotiate ICE are in scope.

items.title: dcmjs DICOM数值校验缺失
items.title_zh: dcmjs DICOM数值校验缺失
items.summary_zh: 攻击者提供特制DICOM数值字段,使解析结果变为非有限值,干扰依赖该库的医疗应用。
items.action_zh: 升级dcmjs至0.52.0及以上版本
items.repro_note: 构造超长或非有限数值字段经DecimalString/IntegerString解析
items.impact_scope: 前端DICOM解析库,医疗影像应用
items.description: dcmjs is a JavaScript implementation of DICOM manipulation. Prior to 0.52.0, the DecimalString and IntegerString implementations in src/ValueRepresentation.js sanitize text with a permissive regular expression and pass the result to JavaScript's Number constructor without validating finiteness or the DICOM value-representation rules.

items.title: SuiteCRM管理员PHP注入致RCE
items.title_zh: SuiteCRM管理员PHP注入致RCE
items.summary_zh: 已登录管理员可在后台注入持久PHP代码,以Web账号执行,完全控制应用与主机。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本;严控管理员权限并审计模板改动
items.repro_note: 管理员登录后在模板/模块编辑处写入PHP,访问页面触发
items.impact_scope: 企业CRM后台,内网核心业务系统
items.description: SuiteCRM is an open-source, enterprise-ready Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software application. An administrator can inject persistent PHP that executes as the web-server account, survives cache clears, and compromises application and host confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

items.title: Cocos AI远程证明未绑定身份
items.title_zh: Cocos AI远程证明未绑定身份
items.summary_zh: 攻击者复用匹配固件与度量的证据即可通过远程证明,冒充合法受信平台接入。
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至0.8.2以上;绑定平台所有者并启用吊销
items.repro_note: 提交与已知平台度量一致的Evidence,验证缺owner绑定与吊销
items.impact_scope: TEE远程证明服务,可信接入根
items.description: In version 0.8.2 and earlier, Cocos AI accepts trusted execution environment attestation Evidence when firmware patch levels and software measurements match, without binding the Evidence to an allowed platform owner or unique machine identity and without enforcing revocation. A remote attacker who controls or compromises another platform trusted by the same verifier can substitute valid Evidence from that platform and cause authorization of the wrong platform.

items.title: MatchPoint安卓客户端证书校验失效
items.title_zh: MatchPoint安卓客户端证书校验失效
items.summary_zh: 网络中间人可利用任意证书信任缺陷解密并篡改App通信,窃取凭据与个人数据。
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级App版本;强制HTTPS并移除宽松TrustManager
items.repro_note: 需能拦截流量,用自签证书代理观察是否接受及明文传输
items.impact_scope: 移动办公客户端,员工个人设备
items.description: Incorrect validation of TLS certificates in the MatchPoint Android app due to a TrustManager that accepts any certificate and a permissive hostname validator. Additionally, the app allows unencrypted HTTP traffic. An attacker capable of intercepting the victim's traffic could read and modify communications, including credentials and personal data.

items.title: 插件环境变量键冲突致权限提升
items.title_zh: 插件环境变量键冲突致权限提升
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造与敏感环境变量同名的插件键,覆盖执行上下文,可致提权或代码执行。
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级平台版本,隔离插件环境变量命名空间
items.repro_note: 构造与敏感环境变量同名的插件配置键,观察上下文被覆盖
items.impact_scope: 插件运行时环境,CI/自动化执行链
items.description: Prior to 0.9.124, an authenticated non-admin with run_events, create_events, or edit_events privilege can supply undeclared keys in event params through api_create_event, api_update_event, or api_run_event. A key that collides with a security-sensitive environment variable can therefore override the plugin execution context and may cause privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, data access, or service disruption depending on the plugin and runtime.

items.title: PowerSYSTEM Center越权访问
items.title_zh: PowerSYSTEM Center越权访问
items.summary_zh: 低权限已认证用户可直接访问管理员专属资源,越权读取或操作电力系统配置。
items.difficulty: 中(需相邻网络·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本;管理接口补角色校验并审计
items.repro_note: 低权限账号直接请求管理员接口,替换路径参数验证越权
items.impact_scope: 电力监控后台,工业内网关键系统
items.description: Incorrect authorization in PowerSYSTEM Center allows a low-privileged, authenticated user to access resources normally limited to administrators.
